name: Shane Riley
tagline: Reporting, writing, producing and broadcasting sports and local news across print, digital, television and radio.
shortBio: Shane Riley is a journalism student at Washington and Lee University with a passion for storytelling and truth-telling across sports and local news. He produces the Rockbridge Report newscast, calls games on the Washington and Lee Sports Network, and reports for The Ring-tum Phi and The News-Gazette.
